What if some movies didn’t just imagine the future… they accurately predicted it?

In this video, I’m exploring a collection of mostly forgotten films that got way closer to reality than anyone expected. From the surveillance state and AI to media manipulation, and even social media culture... these movies aren't just wildly entertaining, they've become shockingly accurate.

I'm  talking about films like Minority Report, Enemy of the State, Contagion, Virtuosity, and more! Movies that now feel less like fiction and more like a prediciton of the world we live in today. Some of these were way ahead of their time. Others feel like they were trying to warn us.
